help.short: The desired region for the name check.
The name to check for availability

description: Checks whether the Batch account name is available in the specified region.

operations.description: Checks whether the Batch account name is available in the specified region.

schema.description: Parameters for a check name availability request.
schema.name: parameters

props.description: The name to check for availability
props.name: name

params.description: The desired region for the name check.
params.name: locationName

params.description: The Azure subscription ID. This is a GUID-formatted string (e.g. 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to be used with the HTTP request.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Gets an error message explaining the Reason value in more detail.
props.name: message

props.description: Gets a boolean value that indicates whether the name is available for you to use. If true, the name is available. If false, the name has already been taken or invalid and cannot be used.
props.name: nameAvailable

props.description: Gets the reason that a Batch account name could not be used. The Reason element is only returned if NameAvailable is false.
props.name: reason

responses.description: Success. Returns details about whether a Batch account name is available.
Error response describing why the operation failed.
